title: Locust load testing script imports cleanly and defines realistic workload patterns

test_cases.name: locustfile imports cleanly
test_cases.input_setup: import locustfile in Python environment with locust installed
test_cases.expected_result: locustfile imports with zero errors or unhandled exceptions

test_cases.name: User model defines realistic pacing (wait_time)
test_cases.expected_result: wait_time and analyze tasks present on class
test_cases.evidence: MedVoiceAnalyzeUser defines wait_time pacing and analyze tasks

test_cases.name: Realistic language and clinical mode distributions
test_cases.input_setup: Check language_names, mode_names, and weights on MedVoiceAnalyzeUser
test_cases.expected_result: Both EN/AR languages and doctor/conversation modes supported with weights

test_cases.name: Synthetic clinical transcripts available for English and Arabic
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect SYNTHETIC_TRANSCRIPTS dictionary across languages and length buckets
test_cases.expected_result: short, medium, long lengths present for both 'en' and 'ar'
test_cases.evidence: Complete synthetic clinical transcripts present for en/ar across short/medium/long

test_cases.name: Granular failure classification helper
test_cases.input_setup: Call _failure_category with simulated TimeoutError and ConnectionError
test_cases.expected_result: Accurate semantic strings returned without swallowing root cause
test_cases.evidence: _failure_category correctly tags Timeout, Connection error, and Stream error
